premise.claim: msgpack 1.2.2 (the base pin) leaks the decoded map value in its C extension when strict_map_key rejects a key (GHSA-j586-36cw-2gc2 / CVE-2026-114613, severity high, 'affected: < 1.2.3, patched: 1.2.3'); 1.2.3 fixes it.
premise.reportedComponent: msgpack runtime dependency of mooncake-transfer-engine-non-cuda in the mooncake e2e image (test/gha-e2e/mooncake/image)
premise.evidence: 25 failed strict_map_key parses: msgpack 1.2.2 +102404 KiB RSS (4096 KiB/parse = full 4 MiB value per parse); msgpack 1.2.3 +0 KiB. results/leak-1.2.2.json vs results/leak-1.2.3.json

liveNote: No separate live layer: the change is a test-image dependency pin. The PR's own kind-e2e-test jobs (5 k8s versions) build test/gha-e2e/mooncake/image from this exact requirements.txt with --require-hashes and run the mooncake e2e suite; all passed on head 0960c0d (results/ci-status.txt).
